identity.catalogVersion: Hash of the event catalog and curated content; join to a versioned catalog export
identity.sessionId: Catalog session identity, scoped to eventId
identity.occurrenceId: A scheduled or unscheduled occurrence of a session
identity.actionId: Random action-scoped UUID; not a visitor, account, or browser-session identity

events.event_selected: Source-observed native-link selection intent, not every event page load
events.session_opened: An explicit session-brief action using a current catalog identity
events.calendar_export_requested: The app initiated a nonempty local ICS download; not a confirmed calendar import
events.custom_guide_created: An explicit successful share-link creation; not an autosave or a count of unique guides
events.shared_guide_opened: A valid, event-matched shared snapshot was displayed
events.catalog_zero_results: A completed search/filter interaction returned no matching sessions; raw queries are excluded

composition.ordering: position is the original zero-based selection order across all parts
composition.unknownReferences: Unknown snapshot references are omitted and counted, never sent as arbitrary identifiers
composition.delivery: Deduplicate retry rows before checking part completeness. Count actions, not rows.

excluded: Guide titles, summaries and personal notes
Encoded guide tokens and URLs, query strings, hashes or referrers
Email, account, persistent visitor and browser-session identities
Automatic page, dependency, exception and device-profile telemetry

storagePrivacy.effect: Remove service-derived browser/OS/device/location and visitor/session/operation fields before new rows are stored
storagePrivacy.historicalData: The transformation does not retroactively alter pre-transformation smoke-test records

limitations: Only permitted, client-observed actions are represented; consent and blockers reduce coverage
Public browser ingestion cannot prove that a sender is a genuine visitor
Multipart actions can arrive partially; reports must disclose incompleteness
The SDK sampling rate is 100 percent, but delivery is still best effort
Do not interpret action counts as unique users, attendance, reservations, or completed calendar imports
